title: Compassionate Access of the Miltenyi Device for CD34+ Cell Selection
official: Compassionate Access of the Miltenyi Device for CD34+ Cell Selection
summary:
Objectives:

Primary Objective

To provide compassionate access to the Miltenyi device for CD34+ cell infusions to patients who experience poor graft function after stem cell transplantation (SCT).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1\) Patients who have poor or no graft function post stem cell transplantation.

Exclusion Criteria:

N/A

sites.f: University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center
